verdict.rationale: Render ships official SDKs for TypeScript and Python workflow tasks (render-docs-22, render-docs-23), plus a REST API with a documented OpenAPI spec (render-docs-15, render-probe-3) and an official CLI (render-docs-14, render-probe-4), all of which AI-native developers can build against programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK usage quality and broader language SDK coverage beyond TypeScript/Python.
